name: obs-bridge
description: Native, reversible OBS Studio control for Codex through obs-websocket.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and control OBS with verified rollback
interface.longDescription: Inspect OBS Studio through its native WebSocket API, apply narrow scene and input plans, verify every effect by readback, and roll back only bridge-created resources.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my running OBS Studio instance
Apply a reversible OBS scene plan
Roll back an OBS Bridge receipt
